root_cause.text: The idle-skip optimization bypassed the GuC suspend/resume sequence for idle exec queues during system suspend, preventing the GPU context switch that flushes TLB entries for invalidated userptr VMAs, leading to missed TLB invalidation and potential page faults in LR/preempt-fence VM mode.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "The idle-skip optimization bypasses GuC suspend, so the GPU may not perform the context switch that flushes TLB entries for invalidated userptr VMAs. In LR/preempt-fence VM mode, this can lead to missed TLB invalidation and page faults during userptr invalidation tests." The patch reverts the optimization and restores unconditional schedule toggling.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove unused static inline function `xe_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend` and its documentation from the header.
intent_record.what: Removed the static inline function `xe_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend` and its kernel-doc comment from the header file.
intent_record.how: The function is no longer available for callers; if there were none, there is no functional change.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove the unused `EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND` flag definition to simplify state enums.
intent_record.what: Removed the preprocessor macro definition `EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND` which was previously assigned the bit mask `(1 << 11)`.
intent_record.how: The removal eliminates the possibility of using this flag in code, so any code that previously set or checked this bit will no longer compile unless the usage is also removed. At runtime, the feature to skip suspend when the queue is idle is no longer available, altering the behavior related to queue suspension.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove unused or obsolete idle skip suspend helper functions to simplify the code.
intent_record.what: Removed three static helper functions `exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend`, `set_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend`, and `clear_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend` that operated on the `EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND` bit in the GuC state of an exec queue.
intent_record.how: Deletes the functions that provided read, set, and clear operations for the idle skip suspend flag. Any existing callers will break; the feature to skip suspend for idle queues using this flag is removed from the codebase.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential missing ring tail update during restore/replay by unconditionally setting the ring tail for non-parallel queues.
intent_record.what: Removed the condition `!exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend(q)` from the else-if branch, changing it to a plain else, so that `xe_lrc_set_ring_tail` is called unconditionally for non-parallel queues when the outer condition is true.
intent_record.how: Previously, for non-parallel queues, the ring tail was only updated if the queue was not in an idle skip suspend state. Now it is always updated for non-parallel queues, regardless of idle skip suspend status.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove the idle skip suspend check to fix a bug where suspend messages were incorrectly ignored for idle queues.
intent_record.what: Removed the local variable 'idle_skip_suspend' and its assignment from 'xe_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend(q)', and removed the '!idle_skip_suspend' condition from the if statement in '__guc_exec_queue_process_msg_suspend'.
intent_record.how: Previously, the suspend processing would be skipped when the queue was idle and skip suspend was set. Now the condition no longer checks idle skip, so suspension proceeds even if the queue is idle, allowing the wait_event and subsequent suspend actions to execute.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix suspend path by always marking the exec queue as suspended and signaling the fence, and remove unused sched_context function.
intent_record.what: Removed the conditional call to set_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend() in __guc_exec_queue_process_msg_suspend when idle_skip_suspend is true, and deleted the static function sched_context.
intent_record.how: Previously, if idle_skip_suspend was set, the queue would skip being marked suspended and the fence would not be signaled; now the queue is always marked suspended and fence signaled regardless. The removed sched_context function is no longer used.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove idle skip suspend handling from GuC exec queue resume to streamline the resume path, as the flag is no longer needed or handled elsewhere.
intent_record.what: Removed all code related to checking and clearing exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend flag in __guc_exec_queue_process_msg_resume, including the reset of LRC ring tail and scheduling of context.
intent_record.how: The resume path no longer performs special handling for the idle skip suspend flag; it no longer clears the flag or adjusts the LRC tail when resuming a suspended queue that was idle. The flag is simply ignored, simplifying the resume logic.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix suspend of faulting LR queues by removing idle skip logic, ensuring all such queues are suspended and marked for resume, and making dependency check unconditional.
intent_record.what: Removed the idle_skip_suspend local variable, the xe_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend call, and the conditional increment of a skip counter; changed need_resume assignment from conditional OR to unconditional true; and simplified the -EAGAIN condition from (!idle_skip_suspend && has_deps) to just has_deps.
intent_record.how: All faulting LR queues are now always suspended and marked for resume regardless of idle state; dependency check now fails the entire operation if has_deps is true, even for previously idle queues; the skip counter is no longer incremented.

The group removes the EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND flag, which is directly related to the idle-skip optimization that caused the vulnerability. Removing this flag eliminates the mechanism that bypassed the GuC suspend/resume sequence, thus addressing the root cause.

The group's fix addresses ring tail updates during restore/replay, while the vulnerability root cause concerns TLB invalidation from idle-skip optimization bypassing GuC suspend/resume. No direct connection.

The group removes the idle-skip logic for LR queues, which is the core of the vulnerability root cause. By ensuring all such queues are suspended and marked for resume, it addresses the missed TLB invalidation due to skipped suspend/resume sequence.

The group directly fixes the suspend path by ensuring idle exec queues are marked as suspended and fences signaled, which addresses the idle-skip optimization bypass that caused missed TLB invalidation.

candidates.rationale: Computes the idle_skip_suspend flag that determines whether the suspend message is sent to GuC, potentially bypassing the entire suspend operation.
This condition gates the entire GuC suspend message and disable scheduling; when idle_skip_suspend is true, the block is skipped, preventing the context switch that flushes TLB entries.

When suspend_pending is set, this checks idle_skip_suspend to decide whether to set the flag instead of performing the actual suspend operations (disable_scheduling), skipping the TLB flush context switch.
Sets the idle skip suspend flag, marking the queue as having skipped the full suspend sequence, which later prevents proper re-enable of scheduling that would have flushed TLB.

In the resume path, this condition checks the idle skip flag and either bypasses the full resume (calling sched_context directly) or handles the skipped suspend incorrectly, missing necessary TLB invalidation.
